files.mbr.py:
# SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
# Write a minimal MBR partition table: Linux (0x83) entries from sector pairs.
import fcntl, os, struct, sys
args = [int(x) for x in sys.argv[3:]]
sector = bytearray(512)
struct.pack_into('<I', sector, 440, 0x0b0e0e0e)
for n in range(len(args) // 2):
    start, size = args[2 * n], args[2 * n + 1]
    struct.pack_into('<B3sB3sII', sector, 446 + 16 * n, 0, b'\xfe\xff\xff', 0x83, b'\xfe\xff\xff', start, size)
sector[510:512] = b'\x55\xaa'
fd = os.open(sys.argv[1], os.O_WRONLY)
os.pwrite(fd, bytes(sector), 0)
os.fsync(fd)
os.close(fd)
if sys.argv[2] != '-':
    fd = os.open(sys.argv[2], os.O_RDONLY)
    fcntl.ioctl(fd, 0x1261)
    os.close(fd)
